title: Senior Developer 2
description:
As a Senior Developer for Arctic Wolf s Data Platform, you ll work on the team that focusses on building the systems that allow for the storage and rapid searching of data focused on cyber security. You ll work within the exciting intersection of big data, distributed computing, cloud technologies and infrastructure as code. Our existing stacks include both custom built and open source components written in Python, Go or Java, deployed within Amazon Web Services. We leverage both Kubernetes and other containerized platforms. Some major components we use include Kafka, Elasticsearch, Databricks, and Spark along with various other components and additional custom application services developed in-house.

Implementation and design of new analytics products, taking customer requirements into account
Maintenance of our existing Python, Java, and Go based systems
Deployment and configuration of open source components
Improve our capabilities to operate and scale reliably as we grow

Once a year we hold a department-wide Hackathon, teaming up across all R&D teams over four days to collaborate and build cool ideas outside the normal project scope. While innovation and experimentais the focus, some of these ideas do make it into our products.

You re an experienced Developer with 4+ Yrs of experience who enjoys solving complex technical challenges with little to no guidance. You care about writing quality code that is maintainable. Working collaboratively in cross-functional teams is your thing. Colleagues look to you for guidance on software development best practices.
You should have extensive work experience in the following areas:
Significant experience with working on backend systems
Excited about working in the big data space
Relevant experience developing software in either Python, Go, or other object oriented languages
Comprehensive experience in software development integrating with RESTful API interfaces
Experience with either SQL or Elasticsearch DSL query languages
Prior development working with message queue systems such as Amazon SQS, Kafka or others
Experience with columnar and/or time-series databases (e.g. Databricks, Elasticsearch, ClickHouse, etc)
Ability to work cohesively within a team and habitually spread knowledge in various forms (verbally, documentation)
Ability, comfort, and interest in picking up new technologies and frameworks which you may not be familiar with
Experience with Amazon Web Services
Understanding of Kubernetes

description:
The Data Architect is responsible for designing, governing, and optimizing an organization s data architecture with a primary focus on treating data as a strategic asset. This role ensures that data is accurate, accessible, secure, interoperable, and aligned with business goals. The Data Architect works across business, technology, and analytics teams to create data models / data product, standards, and architectures that empower advanced analytics, AI, automation, and digital transformation.
Required
Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Management, or related field.
8-12 years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, or database development.
Expertise in database technologies (SQL, NoSQL), data mining, and programming languages like Python, Scala, Java.
Proficiency in data modelling (Canonical Data Model, Semantic Data Model) and schema design.
Familiarity with ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) tools and processes for efficiently transforming and loading data.
Hands-on experience with cloud data platforms (GCP/Azure/AWS) and modern data processing tools.
Solid understanding of data governance, data quality, metadata management and master data management(MDM), referenced data management, transactions data management.
Experience with data lakehouse architectures, data mesh, or data fabric.
Familiarity with structural and non structural like big data tools (Hadoop/Spark, Kafka, Databricks, Big Query).
Experience supporting AI/ML workloads with high-quality data structures.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to create clear architecture artifacts and documentation.
Adaptability and a commitment to continuous learning to stay updated with evolving technologies.
Good To have
Master s degree or relevant certifications (GCP Data Engineer/Azure/AWS Data Architect, TOGAF).
Exposure to GCP data service like (Postgres, Big Query etc.)
Exposure in Automative Industry.
Data Strategy and Architecture Design: Developing and optimizing database models and overall data architecture to store and retrieve company information efficiently. This includes creating blueprints for developing, testing, and maintaining databases.
Translating Business Requirements: Collaborating with business leaders and teams to translate information requirements into data-centric solutions, including databases, data warehouses, and data streams.
Data Modelling and Management: Designing conceptual and logical data models and flowcharts, defining database structures, and creating procedures to ensure data accuracy and accessibility.
Ensuring Data Quality, Integrity, and Security: Focusing on improving data quality, accessibility, and security across all systems and platforms. This involves defining security and backup procedures and ensuring compliance with data regulations like GDPR and data governance guidelines.
System Implementation and Optimization: Installing and configuring information systems, migrating data from legacy systems to new solutions, and improving system performance through testing, troubleshooting, and integrating new elements.
Collaboration and Coordination: Working closely with product mangers, product owners, software developers, and other IT teams to implement data-related solutions and realize end-to-end data strategies.
Technology Evaluation: Evaluating and recommending new technologies to enhance data management and supporting data analytics, AI solutions, and business intelligence projects with a well-designed data landscape.
Adherence to Standards: Ensuring that industry-accepted data architecture principles and standards are integrated and followed for modelling, stored procedures, replication, regulations, and security.

The Senior Test Engineer will act as the quality owner for the Informatica-to-dbt migration program. This role is responsible for defining, implementing, and governing the end-to-end testing strategy across Extract, Load, and Transform (ELT) layers.

Row counts
Schema alignment
Data completeness
Data type consistency
dbt Transformation Testing

Pre- vs post-migration reconciliation
Business rule and aggregation validation
Incremental vs full-load logic
Schema/data tests (familiarity with dbt testing framework preferred)

You won't be a "cog in the machine." You will have the freedom to build, automate, and innovate. We value results and logic over hours spent on manual work.

This is a senior-level, hands-on architecture role focused on enabling seamless digital workflows, integrating platform capabilities with AI/ML and data-driven insights, and ensuring technical excellence across customer-facing applications.
You will work at the intersection of product, engineering, platform, data, and AI teams to architect solutions that enhance user experience, deliver personalized customer journeys, and drive measurable business outcomes. Translate complex designs into accessible, secure services ensuring observability, performance, and operational excellence while mentoring architects and senior engineers.
Provide thought leadership on emerging technologies and foster a culture of technical excellence.
To be successful in this role you have
Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powe'red tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AIs potential impact on the function or industry.
15+ years in enterprise software architecture, solution design, or technical leadership with significant CRM and enterprise SaaS platform experience.
Proven track record designing production-grade solutions across customer service, digital workflows, CRM, or customer experience platforms.
Deep expertise in microservices, event-driven architectures, API-first design, cloud-native technologies, and security best practices.
Strong understanding of AI/ML systems with hands-on experience in personalization, NLP/NLU, semantic search, or conversational AI.
Experience with data platform architecture including data modeling, ETL/ELT pipelines, streaming, data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks), and data governance.
Familiarity with ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face), MLOps tools, and data processing tools (Spark, dbt, Airflow).
Excellent communication skills with ability to influence stakeholders across cross-functional, matrixed global organizations.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with ServiceNow platform and extending its capabilities through custom applications or intelligent services.
Deep understanding of CRM platforms (Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, ServiceNow CSM) and their integration with customer experience ecosystems.
Background in customer journey orchestration, personalized digital experiences, or recommendation engines in large-scale SaaS environments.
Hands-on experience with LLM integration, prompt engineering, RAG, and vector databases for GenAI applications.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and experience in global, matrixed organizations.

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Finance Tech Lead to drive the integration, optimization, and support of our NetSuite ERP system while preparing for a potential ERP transition in the next 1-2 years. This role requires a techno-functional leader who understands finance operations deeply and can act as a strategic partner to both technical teams and business stakeholders.

ERP System Management (NetSuite):
Oversee the day-to-day management, configuration, and optimization of the NetSuite ERP system. Collaborate with finance and operations teams to gather requirements and implement system enhancements. Lead end-to-end NetSuite projects, including integrations with other systems such as Salesforce, procurement, and HR tools. Monitor and resolve NetSuite-related issues, ensuring system uptime and reliability. Develop and enforce best practices, documentation, and standard operating procedures for NetSuite usage.
ERP Transition Planning:
Conduct gap analyses to identify business and technical requirements for a potential ERP transition. Work with cross-functional teams to evaluate and select a future ERP system, ensuring alignment with organizational goals. Create and execute a roadmap for a seamless migration, including data migration, process re-engineering, and user training.
Finance Tech Leadership:
Serve as the primary liaison between the finance and IT teams to ensure alignment on technology initiatives. Develop dashboards and reporting tools to support financial analysis, forecasting, and decision-making. Provide thought leadership on leveraging technology to enhance finance processes, such as procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, and financial close.
Team Collaboration and Mentorship:
Lead and mentor a team of technical and functional analysts, ensuring skill development and knowledge sharing. Work closely with stakeholders to prioritize project pipelines and ensure timely delivery of initiatives.

Bachelors degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or related field; MBA or equivalent is a plus.
10+ years of experience working in finance systems, with at least 3 years of hands-on NetSuite experience.
Strong techno-functional expertise, including system configurations, scripting, workflows, and customizations in NetSuite.
Proven experience in ERP evaluation, selection, and implementation.

description:
Job Title: Product Manager - Make- MES, Quality

ABOUT UNILEVER:
Be part of the world s most successful, purpose-led business. Work with brands that are well loved around the world, that improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We promote innovation, big and small, to make our business win and grow; and we believe in business as a force for good. Unleash your curiosity, challenge ideas and disrupt processes; use your energy to make this happen. Our brilliant business leaders and colleagues provide mentorship and inspiration, so you can be at your best. Every day, nine out of ten Indian households use our products to feel good, look good and get more out of life giving us a unique opportunity to build a brighter future.
Every individual here can bring their purpose to life through their work. Join us and you ll be surrounded by inspiring leaders and supportive peers. Among them, you ll channel your purpose, bring fresh ideas to the table, and simply be you. As you work to make a real impact on the business and the world, we ll work to help you become a better you.
ABOUT UNIOPS:
PURPOSE OF THE ROLE
Unilever is embarking on a business transformation program which will transform its existing operating model to a simplified, global model which will be able to adopt AI enabled processes.
Key enabler of the program is replacement of existing 4 regional SAP ECC based ERP systems with a Global fit to standard SAP S4HANA system.
Purpose of Job:
As Product Lead for Make - MES , Quality within the Program, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and delivering end-to-end digital solutions that drive Unilever s enterprise transformation agenda. This role is central to the success of the program and encompasses leadership across ERP and adjacent solution tracks.
You will be responsible for owning the full lifecycle of solution delivery implementing the harmonized process from system design to deployment ensuring alignment with Program principles such as clean-core ERP, lean architecture, and scalable, integrated solutions. Your scope spans delivery of solution on the core for critical business processes in Manufacturing & Quality Management , where you will guide the team through transformation while ensuring operational continuity during the duration of the program.
You will be accountable for the delivery of technical and functional solutions on core ERP and partnering with satellite applications for landing the program for Make-MES, Quality area. You will be required to partner closely with Business product domains (where destination architecture is in place and/or remediation of the layer 1 applications- as required) to co-create scalable, integrated end to end solutions that reflect Program Principles, industry best practices, and lean-core standards. Your leadership will be critical in aligning with business priorities, advocating harmonized processes, and enabling successful transformation to co-create scalable, integrated end to end solutions that reflect Program Principles through-
Resolving functional roadblocks through hands-on engagement with process owners and delivery teams.
Managing the transition from four legacy SAP ECC systems to a unified ERP platform for the process area.
Ensuring stability, cost-efficiency, and scalability of the future application landscape.
Additionally, you will work in close alignment with Data, Integration, AI Strategy, and Cloud teams to shape a future-ready ecosystem that supports Unilever s digital ambitions and operational excellence.
Key Accountabilities :
Strategic Leadership
Drive the delivery of digital solutions for Make and Quality, aligning with Program s destination architecture, enterprise goals, and global process designs. Embed strategic priorities into solution delivery to enable simplification, standardisation, and harmonisation across markets.
End-to-End Solution Ownership
Lead the design, build, and deployment of ERP and related satellite applications for Make and Quality, working closely with platform owners and business product domains. Ensure seamless integration and transition from legacy SAP ECC systems to a unified ERP landscape.
Process Harmonisation & Optimisation
Champion standardised, simplified processes for manufacturing and quality that reduce complexity, enhance compliance, and enable innovation across the application ecosystem.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner with Global Process Owners, System Integrators, and Business Product Domain Teams to co-create scalable, clean-core solutions aligned with best practices and business needs.
Technical & Functional Stewardship
Provide decisive, hands-on leadership to resolve technical and functional challenges, ensuring timely , high-quality delivery across integrated applications. Act as the strategic link between business objectives and technology capabilities translating goals into scalable, low/no-customisation solutions in close partnership with Process Owners.
Future-Ready Architecture
Collaborate with Data, Integration, AI Strategy, and Cloud teams to shape a stable, cost-effective, and scalable digital ecosystem aligned with Program principles. Enable AI-driven automation and predictive analytics for manufacturing and quality processes.
Transformation Leadership
Partner with Product Partners, System Integrators, and Enterprise Architecture to enable the To-Be application landscape. Own the integrated technology delivery plan across all lifecycle stages from functional and technical design to implementation and go-live.
Delivery & Governance
Establish clear objectives , priorities, and deliverables for each release. Drive accountability for quality outcomes and ensure alignment with business goals through close engagement with process owners and stakeholders.
Experience & Qualifications :
This role demands a blend of strategic foresight, technical acumen, and strong stakeholder engagement to ensure that the transformation delivers tangible business value.
15+ years of experience across technology and functional roles, with leadership in large-scale ERP and manufacturing transformation programmes.
Expertise in ERP implementations in areas of SAP Manufacturing , QM, MDM, PP, PPDS, WM- including configuration, process setup, and system integration.
Strong understanding of Unilever s Make and Quality business models, with working knowledge across Procurement, Finance, Customer Development, and Operations.
Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and System Integrators through design, development, and deployment phases.
Skilled in aligning technical solutions with strategic business goals and driving complex change across multiple markets.
Familiarity with Unilever s enterprise applications, product landscape, and master data structures relevant to manufacturing and quality.
Extensive experience in enterprise applications, integration frameworks, and scalable solution design for shopfloor and quality processes.
Domain expertise in Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Manufacturing Operations, Production Planning and Scheduling, MDG, Quality Management, Production Models/BoM , Material Resource Planning and related ERP modules, with a focus on process harmonisation and optimisation.
End-to-end solution delivery ownership across technical and functional domains.
Proficient in project and programme management within agile environments.
Strategic thinker with strong problem-solving skills and stakeholder engagement capabilities.
Advocate of fit-to-standard and lean-core architecture principles.
Knowledgeable in data migration, integration platforms, AI strategy, and cloud ecosystems.
Leadership Skills
CARE DEEPLY: We care about how consumers experience our brands, the growth and development of our people, and their impact on the planet. We emphasize the importance of performance and care, moving from ambiguity about success to fairness and transparency.
FOCUS ON WHAT COUNTS: We prioritize what truly matters, setting clear and stretching goals. We aim to shift from having everything as a priority to focusing on fewer, bigger things that are delivered to conclusion and are being rewarded.
STAY THREE STEPS AHEAD: We encourage bold and creative thinking to make breakthroughs in performance. We focus on anticipating and staying ahead of consumer needs and external trends, shifting from reacting to leading, shaping, and disrupting the market.
DELIVER WITH EXCELLENCE: The emphasis is on delivering everything with excellence and pace, taking personal ownership, and holding each other accountable. We aim to shift from pride in thinking to pride in execution, developing breakthrough solutions and ensuring the best outcomes.
Our commitment to Equality, Diversity & Inclusion
Unilever embraces diversity and encourages applicants from all walks of life ! This means giving full and fair consideration to all applicants and continuing development of all employees regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage and civil partnership, and pregnancy and maternity.

description:
Job Title: Architect - Data Modeling
Location: Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad.
Who we are
Tiger Analytics is a global leader in AI and analytics, helping Fortune 1000 companies solve their toughest challenges. We offer full stack AI and analytics services & solutions to empower businesses to achieve real outcomes and value at scale. We are on a mission to push the boundaries of what AI and analytics can do to help enterprises navigate uncertainty and move forward decisively. Our purpose is to provide certainty to shape a better tomorrow.
Our team of 4000+ technologists and consultants are based in the US, Canada, the UK, India, Singapore and Australia, working closely with clients across CPG, Retail, Insurance, BFS, Manufacturing, Life Sciences, and Healthcare. Many of our team leaders rank in Top 10 and 40 Under 40 lists, exemplifying our dedication to innovation and excellence.
We are a Great Place to Work-Certified (2022-24), recognized by analyst firms such as Forrester, Gartner, HFS, Everest, ISG and others. We have been ranked among the Best and ‘Fastest Growing’ analytics firms lists by Inc., Financial Times, Economic Times and Analytics India Magazine.
Curious about the role? What your typical day would look like?
As an Architect, you will work to solve some of the most complex and captivating data management problems that would enable them as a data-driven organization; Seamlessly switch between roles of an Individual Contributor, team member, and Data Modeling Architect as demanded by each project to define, design, and deliver actionable insights.
On a typical day, you might
Engage the clients & understand the business requirements to translate those into data models.
Analyze customer problems, propose solutions from a data structural perspective, and estimate and deliver proposed solutions.
Create and maintain a Logical Data Model (LDM) and Physical Data Model (PDM) by applying best practices to provide business insights.
Use the Data Modelling tool to create appropriate data models
Create and maintain the Source to Target Data Mapping document that includes documentation of all entities, attributes, data relationships, primary and foreign key structures, allowed values, codes, business rules, glossary terms, etc.
Gather and publish Data Dictionaries.
Ideate, design, and guide the teams in building automations and accelerators
Involve in maintaining data models as well as capturing data models from existing databases and recording descriptive information.
Contribute to building data warehouse & data marts (on Cloud) while performing data profiling and quality analysis.
Use version control to maintain versions of data models.
Collaborate with Data Engineers to design and develop data extraction and integration code modules.
Partner with the data engineers & testing practitioners to strategize ingestion logic, consumption patterns & testing.
Ideate to design & develop the next-gen data platform by collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders.
Work with the client to define, establish and implement the right modelling approach as per the requirement
Help define the standards and best practices
Involve in monitoring the project progress to keep the leadership teams informed on the milestones, impediments, etc.
Coach team members, and review code artifacts.
Contribute to proposals and RFPs
What do we expect?
10+ years of experience in Data space.
Decent SQL knowledge
Able to suggest modeling approaches for a given problem.
Significant experience in one or more RDBMS (Oracle, DB2, and SQL Server)
Real-time experience working in OLAP & OLTP database models (Dimensional models).
Comprehensive understanding of Star schema, Snowflake schema, and Data Vault Modelling. Also, on any ETL tool, Data Governance, and Data quality.
Eye to analyze data & comfortable with following agile methodology.
Adept understanding of any of the cloud services is preferred (Azure, AWS & GCP)
Enthuse to coach team members & collaborate with various stakeholders across the organization and take complete ownership of deliverables.
Experience in contributing to proposals and RFPs
Good experience in stakeholder management
Decent communication and experience in leading the team
You are important to us, let’s stay connected!
Every individual comes with a different set of skills and qualities so even if you don’t tick all the boxes for the role today, we urge you to apply as there might be a suitable/unique role for you tomorrow.
We are an equal-opportunity employer. Our diverse and inclusive culture and values guide us to listen, trust, respect, and encourage people to grow the way they desire.
Note: The designation will be commensurate with expertise and experience. Compensation packages are among the best in the industry.

We are seeking a seasoned ServiceNow ITOM Implementation Specialist to lead a greenfield rollout of IT Operations Management (ITOM). Lead unit/SIT/UAT, performance tuning (MID throughput, ECC queue), and rollout planning.
Create runbooks, admin guides, and conduct training for platform/ops teams.
Implement access controls, data protection (credentials vaulting, key management), and ensure compliance with security standards.
Establish operational processes (CMDB change control, exception handling, discovery failures, credential-less discovery).
Required Skills & Qualifications
Hands-on ServiceNow ITOM across at least two domains: Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management/AIOps; plus strong CMDB/CSDM knowledge.
Proficiency in MID Server setup and troubleshooting, ECC Queue, patterns/probes, and credential strategies (SSH keys, WMI, SNMP, certificates).
Experience integrating with monitoring/observability platforms (SCOM/Nagios/Zabbix/SolarWinds, Dynatrace/AppDynamics/New Relic, Azure Monitor, Amazon CloudWatch, GCP Operations).
Strong understanding of networking (routing, firewalls, NAT, proxies, TLS), OS administration (Windows/Linux), and databases (JDBC discovery).
ServiceNow platform skills: UI policies/business rules, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, Orchestration, Scripted REST, JavaScript/Glide APIs.
Demonstrated ability to define governance, data model, and operating processes for a new (greenfield) environment.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management; ability to lead workshops and translate requirements into technical build.

Bachelors degree in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent.
ServiceNow CSA (Certified System Administrator) required/preferred.
CIS Discovery / CIS Event Management / CIS Service Mapping preferred.
CAD (Application Developer) nice-to-have.

title: Oracle HCM BA
description:
Job Description:

Direct Responsibilities
• Business & Requirements Analysis and as is / to be sessions with HR, Finance, Legal, and line of business stakeholders to capture detailed functional requirements for Absence, Benefits, and Payroll processes.
• Document Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Process Flow Diagrams, and Use Case scenarios; maintain traceability to Oracle Cloud HCM capabilities.
• Perform gap analysis against regulatory and statutory compliance (e.g., ACA, FMLA, ERISA, local tax rules).
• Translate functional requirements into Oracle Cloud HCM configuration for the three modules (e.g., Eligibility Rules, Benefit Plan Design, Payroll Elements, Tax Withholding, Absence Plans, Accrual Policies).
• Create Fast Formulas, Payroll Calculation Rules, and Business Rules for complex earnings/deductions and leave calculations.
• Design integration points with external providers (benefit carriers, tax authorities, time keeping systems) using HCM Data Loader, REST/SOAP APIs, and Boomi or OIC connectors.
• Connecting with the HR business stakeholders to understand the business problem, strategy, constraints and work collaboratively to deliver a roadmap that ensures the overall HR vision is met via workshops
• Conduct gap analysis, provide impact assessments, and make recommendations that offer workable, efficient options to users.
• Mentor and coach junior Business Analysts and has worked on Agile, Jira and ServiceNow tools.
• Prepare EPIC and User Story requirements with a focus on documented acceptance criteria.
• Develop detailed test strategies, test scripts, and data sets for Unit Testing, Integration Testing, System Integration Testing (SIT), and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for each module.
• Execute payroll simulation runs, benefit enrollment cycles, and absence accrual calculations; validate results against statutory tables and internal policies.
• Build training curricula, user guides for HR endusers and administrators.
• Support the rollout plan, including communication, pilot groups, and postgolive hypercare.
Contributing Responsibilities
• Translate functional requirements into Oracle Cloud HCM respective modules configuration (e.g., Fast Formulas, Business Rules, Value Sets, Eligibility Rules, Role Hierarchies) with hands-on.
• Design endtoend Absence/Benefits/Payroll HR processes across modules such as Core HR, Payroll, Benefits, Time & Labor.
• Define data migration strategy for legacy Absence, Benefits, and Payroll data (e.g., from on prem HRIS, ADP, Paychex, third party benefits platforms).
• Build mapping specifications, perform data cleansing, and execute migration loads using HCM Data Loader or bulk APIs.
• Conduct post migration reconciliation and data quality audits.
• Maintain up to date documentation of statutory tax tables, benefit regulations, and leave laws across all operating jurisdictions.
• Participate in internal audit and external compliance reviews; provide evidence of controls for payroll processing and benefit administration.
• Ensure GDPR, CCPA, and other data privacy requirements are met for employee data.
• Serve as the primary liaison between HR, Finance, external benefits carriers, payroll service providers, and Oracle Support.
• Manage service level agreements, issue escalations, and resolution timelines.
• Create and maintain configuration documentation, design diagrams, and data flow maps.
• Participate in Design discussions, test, and maintain HR applications, including customizations and enhancements.
• Recommend changes to current processes to provide more effective use of the HRIS, and take the lead to implement these changes.
• Provide support for HCM, including researching and resolving system issues, unexpected results or process flaws; recommending solutions or alternative methods to meet requirements.
• Liaise with Dev and APS team to maintain and implement mandatory changes for IT infrastructure
Technical & Behavioral Competencies
• 6 - 12years of experience as an HRIS/Business Analyst, with at least 2years focusing on Oracle Cloud HCM Absence, Benefits, and/or Payroll modules.
• Proven experience delivering endtoend implementations or major enhancements (requirements design configuration testing rollout).
• Preferred experience of working in upgrade projects from HRMS, HR tools to Oracle HCM cloud for core hr, payroll, absence and benefit vendor solutions.
• Understanding of technology obsolescence, vulnerabilities, compliance risk, application inventory including DR, RTO/RPO etc.
• Keeps abreast of Oracle Cloud releases, evaluates new features, and recommends enhancements.
• Preferred Experience with global payroll (multi currency, multi jurisdiction) and global benefits administration.
• Exposure to third party benefits carriers (e.g., UnitedHealthcare, Aetna, MetLife) and experience setting up electronic data interchange (EDI) or API integrations.
• Knowledge of time keeping systems (Kronos, UKG, SAP SuccessFactors Time) that feed into payroll/absence.

description:
About The Role  



Project Role :Cloud Platform Engineer




Project Role Description :Designs, builds, tests, and deploys cloud application solutions that integrate cloud and non-cloud infrastructure. Can deploy infrastructure and platform environments, creates a proof of architecture to test architecture viability, security and performance.


Must have skills :AWS Analytics



Good to have skills :NA
Minimum

3 year(s) of experience is required



Educational Qualification :15 years full time education




Summary:As a Cloud Platform Engineer, you will engage in the design, construction, testing, and deployment of cloud application solutions that seamlessly integrate both cloud and non-cloud infrastructures. Your typical day will involve collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure the architecture's viability, security, and performance, while also creating proofs of concept to validate your designs. You will be responsible for deploying infrastructure and platform environments, ensuring that all components work harmoniously together to meet organizational goals and client needs. Your role will require a proactive approach to problem-solving and a commitment to delivering high-quality solutions in a dynamic environment. Key Responsibilities:-Design, develop, and manage robust data pipelines and ETL processes using AWS services (e.g., AWS Glue, Amazon Redshift, Amazon S3, Amazon Kinesis).-Perform data migration from on premises to AWS using AWS services (AWS DMS, AWS SCT etc)-Implement and maintain data models, schemas, and storage solutions to meet business intelligence and analytics needs.-Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and engineering teams to understand data requirements and deliver effective solutions.-Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize data workflows to ensure high performance, accuracy, and availability.-Develop and enforce data security and compliance measures in line with best practices and organizational policies.-Contribute to architecture decisions and provide recommendations for improving data infrastructure.-Document data processes, architectures, and configurations to facilitate knowledge sharing and future reference.-Stay informed about AWS updates and emerging technologies to integrate new features and tools into our data solutions.Technical Requirements:-3-5 years of experience in data engineering, with a strong focus on AWS cloud services.-Proficiency with AWS services such as Amazon S3, AWS Glue, Amazon Redshift, AWS Lambda, and Amazon RDS.-Solid experience with SQL and relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL).-Strong programming skills in languages such as Python, Java, or Scala for data processing and automation.-Experience with data modeling, data warehousing, and ETL/ELT processes.-Understanding of data security practices and regulatory compliance requirements.-Excellent problem-solving abilities and analytical skills.-Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative environment.Preferred
Qualifications:-AWS certifications such as AWS Certified Data Analytics Specialty or AWS Certified Solutions Architect.-Experience with big data technologies like Apache Hadoop, Apache Spark.-Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Amazon QuickSight)

 Qualification 15 years full time education

title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer Senior Job Description

Role Overview
We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer who can own and deliver complex data
engineering solutions, working across data pipelines, transformations, and cloud-based data
platforms.
This role bridges hands-on execution and solution design, ensuring reliability, scalability,
and clarity in data systems used for analytics and AI-driven use cases.

Experience - 4 to 6 years

Location - Pune/Mumbai/Chennai/Hyderabad/Bangalore (Hybrid)

Key Responsibilities

Data Engineering & Solution Ownership
Design, build, and maintain robust and scalable data pipelines using Python, SQL, and modern data engineering frameworks.
Own sub-systems or end-to-end data workflows, from ingestion to curated datasets.
Work with structured and semi-structured data across data warehouses, data lakes, and cloud storage.
Pipeline Orchestration & Processing
Develop and manage data workflows using orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow or equivalent frameworks.
Implement ETL / ELT pipelines using tools such as Databricks, PySpark, or Spark SQL, depending on project needs.
Handle data migrations and integrations from multiple source systems.
Cloud & Platform Enablement
Build and deploy data pipelines in cloud environments (AWS / Azure / GCP).
Work with cloud-native services such as object storage (S3 / ADLS), compute clusters, and containerized environments where applicable.
Optimize pipelines and clusters for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.
Data Quality & Reliability
Implement data validation, quality checks, and monitoring to ensure data accuracy and consistency.
Troubleshoot and resolve pipeline failures and performance issues.
Contribute to maintaining data models, schemas, and technical documentation.
Collaboration & Mentoring
Collaborate closely with data scientists, analysts, backend engineers, and product teams.
Guide and mentor Data Engineers, providing code and design reviews.
Clearly communicate design decisions, trade-offs, and technical concepts to stakeholders.

Must-Have Skills
Strong proficiency in Python and SQL for data processing and transformations.
Solid experience with data modeling, data warehouses, and data lakes.
Hands-on experience with Databricks, Spark / PySpark, or similar distributed data processing frameworks.
Experience designing and managing ETL / ELT pipelines.
Working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP).
Experience with Git-based version control and collaborative development workflows.
Ability to work with APIs and external data sources.

Nice-to-Have Skills
Experience with workflow orchestration tools beyond Airflow.
Exposure to Kubernetes, Docker, or containerized data workloads.
Familiarity with data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, etc.).
Understanding of big data ecosystems (Hadoop, HDFS, YARN, Snowflake).
Experience with data security, governance, or compliance-related data flows.
Relevant certifications in data engineering or cloud technologies.

What Success Looks Like in This Role
You independently own and deliver complex data pipelines or data subsystems.
You reduce ambiguity for junior engineers through clear design and guidance.
Your pipelines are reliable, observable, and production-ready.
You contribute to improving standards, practices, and documentation across the data engineering team.

title: Senior Solutions Architect, AWS India Public Sector
description:
We are known for our customer obsession. Our solutions architecture teams are on the front line of helping customers succeed using AWS technologies. Our team members leverage their deep knowledge of AWS technologies in collaboration with our sales and partner teams to impact how solutions are proposed, architected and implemented for clients. Helping make customer success a reality and seeing the impact in real-time drives our teams to explore new frontiers in leveraging AWS cloud for both commercial and public sector organizations.

If you have worked with Amazon Web Services technologies or have AWS certifications you would like to leverage, we will help you maximize the impact of your skills and knowledge. Along the way, you ll share with and learn from talented team members all focused on helping customers explore the benefits of moving from on-premise infrastructure to the cloud.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there s nothing we can t achieve in the cloud.

Mentorship and Career Growth


As a solutions architect you will provide a consistent approach for customers and partners to evaluate architectures, and implement designs that will scale over time based on five pillars of the AWS Well-Architected Framework operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, and cost optimization.
You will do well in this role if you demonstrate excellent customer-facing communication skills representing technical solutions at senior leadership levels. You thrive on diving deep into complex technology environments and express these as industry standard architecture diagrams and well-articulated solution narratives. You will be right at home if you stay updated on latest technology trends and have a sense of urgency and hunger for learning more about customer business and relevant technology solutions across industries. Solutions architects love to travel, spending time with diverse customers, small and large, self-manage high intensity context switching between competing priorities, and demonstrate a sense of urgency to deliver results.

A day in the life
Delivering to primary responsibilities of a solutions architect you will 1) establish technical credibility in sales cycles for Amazon platforms, technologies, and the company, by collaborating with the sales team to win new business; 2) capture and convey best practices and provide prescriptive guidance around application and systems design on the Amazon platforms and technologies, via direct customer and partner interaction, development of technical content, events, evangelism, training, and operational event support; and 3) help drive the evolution of the Amazon platforms and technologies by providing direct input and feedback from the field to the engineering teams developing these offerings. Finally, tenured team members are tasked with recruiting, hiring, and developing top SA talent; managing and applying that resource in a prudent and efficient way; and driving cross-organizational initiatives related to the areas identified above.

About the team
You re surrounded by innovation. You re empowered with a lot of ownership. Your growth is accelerated. The work is challenging. You have a voice here and are encouraged to use it. Your experience and career development is in your hands. We live our leadership principles every day. At Amazon, its always "Day 1".

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS

Background in B2B data analytics or Sales Operations technology.

1. INTRODUCTION
1.1 Purpose
This document outlines the role of a Database Architect, focusing on the expectations, responsibilities, skills, and career progression for professionals with 12-18 years of experience. It serves as a guide for current Database Architects and HR professionals responsible for talent management.
1.2 Intended Audience and Reading Suggestions
This JD is intended for Database Architects, senior engineers, and technical leaders aiming to gain insights into the responsibilities and career growth for this senior technical role. It is also a valuable resource for hiring managers and HR professionals.
2. DATABASE ARCHITECT PROFILE
2.1 Overview
The Database Architect is responsible for designing, implementing, and managing high-performance and scalable databases. This role ensures that the database architecture aligns with the business requirements, ensures high availability, and maintains security and data integrity. The Database Architect collaborates with IT teams to optimize database performance and implement data solutions that support business growth.
2.2 Key Expectations
Lead the design and implementation of robust and scalable database architectures.
Ensure the availability, security, and performance of enterprise-level databases.
Stay current with evolving database technologies and provide thought leadership.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align database solutions with business needs.
2.3 Key Responsibilities
Database Design & Architecture
Design scalable, reliable, and high-performance database systems that align with business needs.
Implement and maintain complex database structures, including data warehousing and big data solutions.
Collaborate with system architects and developers to ensure seamless integration of database solutions.
Performance & Scalability
Ensure optimal performance and scalability of databases, handling large volumes of transactions.
Lead the design and execution of database performance tuning and troubleshooting initiatives.
Implement and manage indexing, caching, and partitioning strategies to optimize database performance.
Security & Data Integrity
Design and implement database security measures, ensuring compliance with privacy laws and corporate policies.
Ensure data integrity by applying effective backup and disaster recovery strategies.
Perform regular audits and risk assessments to identify vulnerabilities.
Team Leadership & Mentorship
Lead and mentor junior database engineers and architects, providing guidance and career development opportunities.
Conduct training sessions on new database technologies and best practices.
Provide technical leadership in database architecture discussions and decision-making.
2.4 Skills Required
Technical Skills
Advanced knowledge of database management systems (DBMS) like Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, and NoSQL databases.
Experience with cloud-based databases (e.g., AWS RDS, Azure SQL Database).
Proficiency in SQL and database optimization techniques.
Knowledge of data warehousing, ETL processes, and big data architectures.
Expertise in database security, backup, and disaster recovery strategies.
Soft Skills
Strong leadership, mentoring, and team collaboration skills.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong problem-solving capabilities and decision-making skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks effectively.
2.5 Professional Training Requirements
Certification in database management systems (e.g., Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server).
Training in cloud database technologies (AWS, Azure).
Ongoing education in performance tuning, security, and data management best practices.
Leadership and team management training.
2.6 Guidelines to Improve Effectiveness
Regularly monitor and optimize the performance of database systems.
Foster a culture of continuous learning by encouraging team members to stay updated with the latest database technologies.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure that database systems support the overall business strategy.
Document all database architectures, configurations, and operational processes for continuity.
2.7 Key Focus Areas
Designing highly available and scalable database architectures.
Optimizing database performance and resource utilization.
Ensuring data security, compliance, and integrity across all databases.
Leading database innovation and adopting new database technologies.

We are seeking a seasoned ServiceNow ITOM Implementation Specialist to lead a greenfield rollout of IT Operations Management (ITOM). Develop dashboards and reports for service health, discovery coverage, CMDB completeness, and event MTTA/MTTR.
Lead unit/SIT/UAT, performance tuning (MID throughput, ECC queue), and rollout planning.
Create runbooks, admin guides, and conduct training for platform/ops teams.
Implement access controls, data protection (credentials vaulting, key management), and ensure compliance with security standards.
Establish operational processes (CMDB change control, exception handling, discovery failures, credential-less discovery).
Required Skills & Qualifications
Hands-on ServiceNow ITOM across at least two domains: Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management/AIOps; plus strong CMDB/CSDM knowledge.
Proficiency in MID Server setup and troubleshooting, ECC Queue, patterns/probes, and credential strategies (SSH keys, WMI, SNMP, certificates).
Experience integrating with monitoring/observability platforms (SCOM/Nagios/Zabbix/SolarWinds, Dynatrace/AppDynamics/New Relic, Azure Monitor, Amazon CloudWatch, GCP Operations).
Strong understanding of networking (routing, firewalls, NAT, proxies, TLS), OS administration (Windows/Linux), and databases (JDBC discovery).
ServiceNow platform skills: UI policies/business rules, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, Orchestration, Scripted REST, JavaScript/Glide APIs.
Demonstrated ability to define governance, data model, and operating processes for a new (greenfield) environment.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management; ability to lead workshops and translate requirements into technical build.

Bachelors degree in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent.
ServiceNow CSA (Certified System Administrator) required/preferred.
CIS Discovery / CIS Event Management / CIS Service Mapping preferred.
CAD (Application Developer) nice-to-have.

• Perform gap analysis against regulatory and statutory compliance (e.g., ACA, FMLA, ERISA, local tax rules).
• Translate functional requirements into Oracle Cloud HCM configuration for the three modules (e.g., Eligibility Rules, Benefit Plan Design, Payroll Elements, Tax Withholding, Absence Plans, Accrual Policies).

• Connecting with the HR business stakeholders to understand the business problem, strategy, constraints and work collaboratively to deliver a roadmap that ensures the overall HR vision is met via workshops
• Conduct gap analysis, provide impact assessments, and make recommendations that offer workable, efficient options to users.
• Mentor and coach junior Business Analysts and has worked on Agile, Jira and ServiceNow tools.
• Prepare EPIC and User Story requirements with a focus on documented acceptance criteria.
• Develop detailed test strategies, test scripts, and data sets for Unit Testing, Integration Testing, System Integration Testing (SIT), and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for each module.
• Execute payroll simulation runs, benefit enrollment cycles, and absence accrual calculations; validate results against statutory tables and internal policies.
• Build training curricula, user guides for HR endusers and administrators.
• Support the rollout plan, including communication, pilot groups, and postgolive hypercare.
Contributing Responsibilities
• Translate functional requirements into Oracle Cloud HCM respective modules configuration (e.g., Fast Formulas, Business Rules, Value Sets, Eligibility Rules, Role Hierarchies) with hands-on.
• Design endtoend Absence/Benefits/Payroll HR processes across modules such as Core HR, Payroll, Benefits, Time & Labor.
• Define data migration strategy for legacy Absence, Benefits, and Payroll data (e.g., from on prem HRIS, ADP, Paychex, third party benefits platforms).
• Build mapping specifications, perform data cleansing, and execute migration loads using HCM Data Loader or bulk APIs.
• Conduct post migration reconciliation and data quality audits.
• Maintain up to date documentation of statutory tax tables, benefit regulations, and leave laws across all operating jurisdictions.
• Participate in internal audit and external compliance reviews; provide evidence of controls for payroll processing and benefit administration.
• Ensure GDPR, CCPA, and other data privacy requirements are met for employee data.
• Serve as the primary liaison between HR, Finance, external benefits carriers, payroll service providers, and Oracle Support.
• Manage service level agreements, issue escalations, and resolution timelines.
• Create and maintain configuration documentation, design diagrams, and data flow maps.
• Participate in Design discussions, test, and maintain HR applications, including customizations and enhancements.
• Recommend changes to current processes to provide more effective use of the HRIS, and take the lead to implement these changes.
• Provide support for HCM, including researching and resolving system issues, unexpected results or process flaws; recommending solutions or alternative methods to meet requirements.
• Liaise with Dev and APS team to maintain and implement mandatory changes for IT infrastructure
Technical & Behavioral Competencies
• 6 - 12years of experience as an HRIS/Business Analyst, with at least 2years focusing on Oracle Cloud HCM Absence, Benefits, and/or Payroll modules.
• Proven experience delivering endtoend implementations or major enhancements (requirements design configuration testing rollout).
• Preferred experience of working in upgrade projects from HRMS, HR tools to Oracle HCM cloud for core hr, payroll, absence and benefit vendor solutions.
• Understanding of technology obsolescence, vulnerabilities, compliance risk, application inventory including DR, RTO/RPO etc.
• Keeps abreast of Oracle Cloud releases, evaluates new features, and recommends enhancements.
• Preferred Experience with global payroll (multi currency, multi jurisdiction) and global benefits administration.
• Exposure to third party benefits carriers (e.g., UnitedHealthcare, Aetna, MetLife) and experience setting up electronic data interchange (EDI) or API integrations.
• Knowledge of time keeping systems (Kronos, UKG, SAP SuccessFactors Time) that feed into payroll/absence.

title: Hiring Storage Administrator - Pune
description:
SUMMARY
Job Title: Storage Administrator
Location: Pune
Experience: 7-12 years

Summary
The Storage Administrator plays a critical role in ensuring the reliability, security, and performance of enterprise storage systems across on-premises and cloud environments. This position is responsible for the implementation, management, and optimization of storage solutions, including Nasuni, DFS, NTFS permissions, SharePoint, Azure Storage, and Autodesk Construction Cloud. The ideal candidate will ensure seamless data access, robust recovery capabilities, and strict compliance with regulatory standards. By maintaining high availability, automating routine tasks, and supporting strategic migrations, the Storage Administrator enables efficient, secure, and scalable operations that support business continuity and digital transformation across the organization.

- - -

Responsibilities
Ensure reliable recovery of files, folders, and systems across supported storage platforms through point-in-time restores and proactive testing.
Maintain comprehensive recovery documentation and conduct regular drills to validate effectiveness and compliance.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to minimize downtime and maintain business continuity during recovery events.
Provision, configure, and maintain Nasuni appliances, including patching via Dell OpenManage and managing volume connectivity.
Design and manage DFS namespaces to ensure high availability and fault tolerance across the enterprise.
Implement and audit NTFS permissions using best practices, including proper inheritance and cleanup of obsolete access rights.
Establish and manage group-based access controls to enforce security and compliance standards.
Configure drive mappings across platforms using PowerShell, Python, and Bash scripts to automate routine tasks.
Deploy and manage mapped drives via Group Policy Objects (GPO) and Microsoft Intune for modern, secure environments.
Support the integration of SharePoint Online document libraries by importing and organizing project data.
Configure and monitor Azure Storage accounts, including replication (GRS/LRS), secure transfer, and lifecycle management policies.
Advise on the adoption and optimization of Autodesk Construction Cloud for design and engineering workflows.
Enforce security hardening of storage systems in alignment with industry best practices.
Manage access controls and permissions across all platforms to prevent unauthorized access.
Maintain and test data retention policies to meet legal, regulatory (GDPR, HIPAA, SOX), and organizational requirements.
Monitor storage performance and capacity utilization, generating reports to forecast future needs.
Implement optimization strategies to enhance efficiency, performance, and cost - effectiveness.
Troubleshoot complex backup and storage issues in collaboration with system and network teams.
Participate in on-call rotation to address critical incidents outside regular business hours.
Assist in developing and executing data migration plans, including those related to mergers and acquisitions.
Support migrations across diverse storage platforms such as Windows, Nasuni, Synology, and Netgear.
Review migration plans with stakeholders and validate successful post-migration outcomes.


Requirements
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field; relevant certifications (e.g., Microsoft, AWS, or Dell) are a plus.
7-12 years of hands-on experience in storage administration, with a focus on enterprise environments.
Proven experience with Nasuni appliances, including configuration, patching, and troubleshooting.
Strong knowledge of DFS, NTFS permissions, and group-based access control implementation and auditing.
Proficiency in scripting languages such as PowerShell, Python, and Bash for automation and operational efficiency.
Experience with Group Policy Objects (GPO) and Microsoft Intune for centralized drive mapping and device management.
Solid understanding of SharePoint Online and Azure Storage, including replication, security, and lifecycle policies.
Familiarity with Autodesk Construction Cloud and its integration into engineering and design workflows.
Demonstrated ability to manage data retention, compliance, and security policies in regulated environments.
Experience in troubleshooting complex storage and backup issues, including root cause analysis.
Strong collaboration skills with system administrators, network engineers, and application teams.
Willingness to participate in on-call rotations for critical incident response.
Experience in data migration projects, including planning, execution, and validation phases.
Excellent documentation skills and attention to detail in maintaining procedural and compliance records.

Lead Scoring Logic: Collaborate with the sales and marketing teams to develop and deploy multi-factor lead scoring models within the database to prioritize high-value prospects.
AI Agent Development: Design and deploy AI Agents (using frameworks like LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or Azure OpenAI) to crawl the web and social media for real-time data enrichment and intent signals.
CRM & Workflow Automation: Ensure the "Gold" records and lead scores are synced seamlessly via "Upsert" logic to the CRM, triggering automated sales workflows.
Product Evolution: Roadmap the "next phase" of functionality, including predictive modeling, churn analysis, and automated outreach triggers.

"I’ll build the SQL foundation first, but I’m designing it to store the unstructured data our AI agents will find later."
"Lead scoring shouldn't just be based on size; it should include the 'intent signals' our agents scrape from the web."
"I prefer to automate data gathering so our database stays fresh without manual intervention."

Prior experience in a startup or "Phase 1" environment where you were responsible for the initial architecture.
Experience with Beautiful Soup, Selenium, or Playwright for web-based data gathering.
Background in B2B data analytics or Sales Operations technology.

By adding "AI Agents" and "Lead Scoring," you are now looking for a candidate with Python skills in addition to SQL.
SQL will be their "Warehouse" language.
Python will be their "AI/Scraping" language.

1. INTRODUCTION
1.1 Purpose
This document outlines the role of a Database Architect, focusing on the expectations, responsibilities, skills, and career progression for professionals with 12-18 years of experience. It serves as a guide for current Database Architects and HR professionals responsible for talent management.
1.2 Intended Audience and Reading Suggestions
This JD is intended for Database Architects, senior engineers, and technical leaders aiming to gain insights into the responsibilities and career growth for this senior technical role. It is also a valuable resource for hiring managers and HR professionals.
2. DATABASE ARCHITECT PROFILE
2.1 Overview
The Database Architect is responsible for designing, implementing, and managing high-performance and scalable databases. This role ensures that the database architecture aligns with the business requirements, ensures high availability, and maintains security and data integrity. The Database Architect collaborates with IT teams to optimize database performance and implement data solutions that support business growth.
2.2 Key Expectations
Lead the design and implementation of robust and scalable database architectures.
Ensure the availability, security, and performance of enterprise-level databases.
Stay current with evolving database technologies and provide thought leadership.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align database solutions with business needs.
2.3 Key Responsibilities
Database Design & Architecture
Design scalable, reliable, and high-performance database systems that align with business needs.
Implement and maintain complex database structures, including data warehousing and big data solutions.
Collaborate with system architects and developers to ensure seamless integration of database solutions.
Performance & Scalability
Ensure optimal performance and scalability of databases, handling large volumes of transactions.
Lead the design and execution of database performance tuning and troubleshooting initiatives.
Implement and manage indexing, caching, and partitioning strategies to optimize database performance.
Security & Data Integrity
Design and implement database security measures, ensuring compliance with privacy laws and corporate policies.
Ensure data integrity by applying effective backup and disaster recovery strategies.
Perform regular audits and risk assessments to identify vulnerabilities.
Team Leadership & Mentorship
Lead and mentor junior database engineers and architects, providing guidance and career development opportunities.
Conduct training sessions on new database technologies and best practices.
Provide technical leadership in database architecture discussions and decision-making.
2.4 Skills Required
Technical Skills
Advanced knowledge of database management systems (DBMS) like Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, and NoSQL databases.
Experience with cloud-based databases (e.g., AWS RDS, Azure SQL Database).
Proficiency in SQL and database optimization techniques.
Knowledge of data warehousing, ETL processes, and big data architectures.
Expertise in database security, backup, and disaster recovery strategies.
Soft Skills
Strong leadership, mentoring, and team collaboration skills.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong problem-solving capabilities and decision-making skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks effectively.
2.5 Professional Training Requirements
Certification in database management systems (e.g., Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server).
Training in cloud database technologies (AWS, Azure).
Ongoing education in performance tuning, security, and data management best practices.
Leadership and team management training.
2.6 Guidelines to Improve Effectiveness
Regularly monitor and optimize the performance of database systems.
Foster a culture of continuous learning by encouraging team members to stay updated with the latest database technologies.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure that database systems support the overall business strategy.
Document all database architectures, configurations, and operational processes for continuity.
2.7 Key Focus Areas
Designing highly available and scalable database architectures.
Optimizing database performance and resource utilization.
Ensuring data security, compliance, and integrity across all databases.
Leading database innovation and adopting new database technologies.

Sr. Database Architect

Lead Database Architect

Head of Data Architecture

Chief Technology Officer (CTO)

Have I successfully designed database architectures that meet business needs?
Are the database solutions I have implemented optimized for performance and scalability?

Do I stay informed about emerging database technologies and industry best practices?

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced MDM Architect to design, implement, and govern enterprise Master Data Management (MDM) solutions, with a strong focus on Product and Location master data domains. The ideal candidate will define the MDM architecture, data models, governance frameworks, and integration patterns to ensure high-quality, consistent, and trusted master data across the organization.

- Define data models, hierarchies, and relationships for product and location entities.
- Establish data standards, naming conventions, and data governance frameworks.
- Implement data quality rules, validations, and monitoring.
- Ensure data consistency, deduplication, and standardization across systems.
- Design integration patterns between MDM and source/target systems.
- Work with ERP, eCommerce, supply chain, and analytics systems.

- Support multi-country, multi-language, and multi-brand environments.

- Experience in data modeling (logical and physical).

- Knowledge of SQL/NoSQL, ETL tools, and API integrations.
- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
- 10+ years of experience in data architecture or MDM.
- 5+ years working specifically with Product or Location master data.
- Proven experience in enterprise-scale MDM implementations.


Preferred Skills

Stay current with Databricks best practices, Delta Lake features, and emerging data modeling patterns in cloud-based data platforms

The Professional, Data Management & Governance job ensures the accuracy, security and effective use of the organization's moderately complex data. STRATEGIC PLANNING: Implements and supports the development of data management and governance strategies aligned with organizational goals.

DATA LITERACY & TRAINING: Deploys training programs to improve organizational literacy, compliance to data standards and policies and increased understanding of accountability for data responsibilities.

Minimum requirement of 2 years of relevant work experience. Typically reflects 3 years or more of relevant experience in data managment or ERP systems (minimum 2 years).
Fluent in English (spoken and written).
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Solid SAP ERP expereince, especially in Material Master Data and its key views.
Proven ability to collaborate cross-fuunctionally with Supplu Chain, Finance, Manufacturing, and Quality teams.

Experience with Bills of Materials (BOM) creation and maintenance.
